name: com.breastpump/coverage
title: BreastPump.com Coverage Navigator
description: Read-only US breast pump insurance coverage rules by state and plan: type, timing, Rx, next steps.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Explain whether a US family's insurance covers a breast pump: pump types, when to order, Rx rule, next steps, one coverage CTA (paid only for eligible commercial/Marketplace results, and flagged), sources and verification status. Uninsured results list official coverage paths. Any paid referral appears only in the separate sponsored_next_steps array, which is off by default. Don't send personal data.

state.description: 2-letter US state code or name, e.g. TX. DC is supported.

carrier.description: Optional carrier, for commercial or marketplace: uhc, aetna, cigna, bcbs, kaiser, or a name like 'Anthem'

due_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD. A past date is treated as the baby's birth date.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: All 51 jurisdictions (50 states and DC), whether each has a verified state Medicaid rule, and the all-payer referral restriction flag.

tools.name: get_state_rules
tools.description: A summary of coverage for every plan type in one state, with its Medicaid program link.

tools.name: list_carriers
tools.description: Carriers with carrier-specific rules (commercial or marketplace), and whether each is verified.
